scope: Direct evidence on patient/family autonomy, dignity, communication and visitation restrictions during COVID-19 in Japan
raw_source_storage_policy: Publisher-hosted full text/PDFs were inspected. Copyrighted article files were not copied into the public GitHub repository. The original publisher URLs and exact bibliographic identifiers are retained for traceability.

sources.title: COVID-19蔓延下での担がん患者および患者家族，医療従事者への面会制限の心理的影響
sources.design: Single-center anonymous self-administered questionnaire; descriptive statistics; Mann-Whitney U test for ordinal group comparisons; content analysis of free text
sources.population: Adults aged 20 or older with cancer admitted to one hospital and referred to its palliative care center, their family/primary caregivers, and their primary nurses

limitations: The two studies are not directly poolable: one is a small single-center questionnaire study of cancer inpatients/families/primary nurses; the other is a qualitative interview study of six certified nurse specialists.
No individual-level raw survey/interview data were available; extracted results are aggregate published findings only.
Shiraishi et al. supplementary materials have not yet been individually downloaded or audited.
The Shiraishi study excluded patients with altered consciousness and severe depressive symptoms and used a non-randomized small sample.
Matsumoto et al. used purposive/network recruitment of experienced specialists; categories do not estimate prevalence.
The extracted intervention ideas are reported practices or qualitative suggestions, not demonstrated causal effects.
reference_recording_policy: All bibliographic references, including candidates considered, must have complete title, all authors in published order, publication metadata, identifiers, official landing page URL, full-text/PDF/supplement URLs, access timestamp JST, source type, verification state, and unresolved items in the central GitHub reference registry.
